entries.0a250961cc3c8ecc: The company was established on April 1, 2024, as a pure holding company and full parent of Tasuki Co., Ltd. and Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd. through a joint share transfer, and manages the group as a whole. The group consists of the company and 6 subsidiaries (of which ZISEDAI Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. are unconsolidated subsidiaries), and operates the Life Platform Business, the Finance Consulting Business and the SaaS Business (unconsolidated).
entries.189981c6d10847b4: A holding company group whose core is the Life Platform Business, which plans, develops and sells newly built IoT residences for investment, centered on Tokyo's 23 wards.
entries.1ae1999ac7877d02: This business is carried out by Tasuki Co., Ltd., Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd., Aura Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. (unconsolidated).
entries.51f8c67e58184ba6: This business is carried out by unconsolidated subsidiary ZISEDAI Co., Ltd. It develops and sells DX products for the real estate industry. As this business is carried out by an unconsolidated subsidiary and is not included in the reportable segments, its revenue is not disclosed.
entries.6c2e6806b2a2dd3e: This business is carried out by Tasuki Pros Co., Ltd.
entries.767f22b9db01f285: Business of the TASUKI Holdings Group
entries.7e31ed7f6870c47d: This business is carried out by Tasuki Co., Ltd., Shin Nihon Tatemono Co., Ltd., Aura Co., Ltd. and Tasuki Partners Co., Ltd. (unconsolidated). The business plans, develops and sells newly built IoT residences for investment, mainly in Tokyo’s 23 wards; acquires, adds value to and sells used properties for resale (refining properties); plans, develops and sells logistics facilities and similar properties; provides asset consulting for property owners; operates the real estate crowdfunding service “TASUKI FUNDS” and organizes and manages private real estate funds; and acquires, renovates (regenerates), sells and manages vacant houses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥74,211 million.
entries.9ad8b4912491a658: This business is carried out by Tasuki Pros Co., Ltd. Targeting small and medium-sized enterprises among real estate businesses, it plans and provides financial solutions such as real estate-secured loans. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥193 million.
